items.title: Harrison Barnes Interview, 1959-01-29
items.q: And they wanted Charlie McCurdy's, I mean, not Charlie McCurdy's.

ctx.x: And Freddie? Huh? And Freddie Bonds? Baritone.

Alfred Bonds played E-flat clarinet. Now we went to play. We went up about four miles from home to a little dance. And they had a little orchestra there. Playing, you know. And my brothers say, think we can play a little bit? Them fellas? Well, they said, that couldn't be, you know. That was a C, you know, that was a C, C tram on, built-in C, what he had. And my brother plays with an E-flat clarinet. This fella had a B-flat clarinet. And they wanted Charlie McCurdy's, I mean, not Charlie McCurdy's. And now the…
Yeah, it was rolling with G's right there.
